comment: Terra & Mar rebuild (AI 642): the approved plan. Blender frame, metres: front faces -Y, z up, street z 0, the front balcony edge at y -11. Every layer script reads its outlines and levels from here; nothing is hard-coded.

approved.by: user: annotated top view of option A -- drop the rear face, run the rear chamfers on to one square corner ("more aligned to the aerial view"); then cut that point with a rear face as short as the sides; every junction rounded with the same small curvature

decisions.penthouse: keep, set back out of b8's view (about 10 x 7.5 m at the rear of the roof, as in the aerial)
decisions.front_centre_bay: flush loggias between the two full-height pilasters, as b8: slab edges flush with the pilaster faces, glazing at the wall line
decisions.footprint: the rebuild's own (27.0 x 24.5 m); the game's 28 x 22 m podium is a comparison only -- no city spec places Terra & Mar yet
decisions.superseded_prompts: exterior AI 617-626 and 641 (written against the game shells); props AI 627-633 and interiors AI 634-638 retargeted to the rebuild; AI 639 and 640 unchanged

measured.source: calibrate_references.py -> calibration.json, from the points in reference_points.json (b8 camera: horizon from the pedestrians' heads, focal from the chamfer rails' vanishing point, scale from the 3.35 m storey)
measured.rounded_to: front 10.0, chamfers 45 degrees to a 27.0 m width, radius 0.64; b8 and the aerial are AI images (+/-5-10 %)

podium.note: ground + upper podium and the podium roof slab; outline = the balcony edge line with sharp corners (user fix 1, 2026-10-15: b8's podium corners are plain vertical edges)

entrance.note: projecting entrance volume on run A

tower_wall_line.note: glazing / wall line, 1.5 m inside the balcony edge

centre_bay.note: between the pilasters the slab edge is flush with the pilaster faces; the loggia is the 1.5 m behind

penthouse.note: kept out of b8's view: CAM_B8 sees over the roof edge only above this height at its front wall

chamfer_columns.source: b8: the right chamfer's two bays meet at a rounded column (reads 0.9 m past mid-run, within the calibration error)
proposed: the rear chamfers in three bays, close to the front chamfer bay width

structure.comment: AI 643 structure layer. Slab kinds: ground (podium outline + entrance), podium_floor (podium + entrance canopy), podium_roof (podium outline, split at the wall line), residential (balcony edge notched around the front pilasters, split at the wall line), roof (balcony edge). Every slab has a hole at the core.

terrace.note: user fix 3 (2026-10-15): the floor-1 storey of each pilaster stands inside the terrace, its face on the guard shoe's back face; the floor-1 guard runs on in front of it (b8)

roof_frame.note: user fix 9 (2026-10-15): the pilasters run on up through the roof band as a frame, the head between them in their plane, a stone cap in segments over both (b8)

rear_bay_check.why: three bays (-11 %) sit much closer to the front chamfers' bay than two (+33 %)

columns.note: user fix 10 (2026-10-15): the room-dividing columns are piers out to the guard's outer face (proud = from the wall line); the guard runs stop against them

core.note: stair + two lifts under the penthouse rectangle, rising to the underside of the penthouse roof slab, which covers it; CAM_B8 sees over the roof edge at the core's front wall only above hidden_from_b8_up_to_m

fit.method: least squares over the b8 picks, each paired with its plan point (b8_camera_fit.py)

aerial.note: fitted to the aerial's roof plane only: its facades cannot share one camera

returns.comment: 2026-10-14 stone returns and connection joints: where the stone stops at another material on an outside corner it wraps the corner (`return` at the entrance and loggia jambs and heads, `fascia_return` under the slab fascias; flush with the next material's face, arris eased by `arris`), then a shadow gap `gap` wide and `gap_depth` deep (TM_RB_stone_joint) before the wood; an inside corner (stone side wall -> wood panel) gets the same gap

envelope.comment: AI 644 glazing on the tower wall line: positions in metres along each bay from a; v = offset from the wall line (outward +). Floors 1-5 = the storeys above the podium roof. Panes listed in doors slide (the balconies layer puts thresholds there).

balconies.comment: AI 645 balconies: the walking surface from the frames' outer face to the guard shoe, split at the pilasters and cut at the room-dividing piers (user fix 10, 2026-10-15); guard runs on the guard line, stopping against the pilasters and the piers (guard_run_ends: open = the glass runs to a pilaster's side, stop = an end post against a pier; floor 1: terrace_guard_runs, in front of the pilasters, user fix 3, from pier to pier); the soffits' veneer plates (soffit_veneer, user fix 17) with one downlight at the centre of each light-course plate, every rim clear_wall from a wall / pier / pilaster and clear_edge from the slab edge (user fix 14; downlight_check); planter slots (pots per bay and floor) and the podium-edge planter strips (floor 1) are reserved for props AI 627 / 628.

downlight_check.note: user fix 17: one light per light-course plate, at its centre; rims measured in plan (fix 14): stop = a pier or pilaster face, wall = the window frames' outer face, edge = the slab edge (the same points under every soffit, floors 1-5)

soffit_veneer.comment: user fix 17 (2026-10-15): the balcony soffits' veneer plates (the same under every soffit, floors 1-5; layer_balconies.py): plan loops, u = the grain's direction, p0 / n the leg's corner and inward normal (UVs: along = (p - p0) . u + dv, across = (p - p0) . n - t0), w the plate's width across the grain; courses_t = the course lines' depth from the slab edge

light_check.note: user fix 17: one light per band plate, at its centre; the end plates' centres allow this rim to the linings (fix 14 asked clear_wall)

veneer_panels.comment: user fix 15 (2026-10-15): the veneer plates' joints (VENEER_PANELS): rows = z, lining = y, vestibule / panel = |x| (mirrored), soffit / band = x

sign.note: sized from b8 through CAM_B8 (visible glyph widths 3.85 and 2.54 m); the kit's 3.2 / 2.1 m are its suggested working scale, not a survey

courses.comment: user fix 13b (2026-10-15): one course height for the podium; the design datums (PODIUM's) moved onto its planes (podium_course_datums)

loggia_cover.comment: user fix 2 (2026-10-15): the curved cover over the upper-podium loggia, its own piece (layer_podium.py rb_loggia_cover) in the podium roof slab's notch (layer_structure.py); x from the centre line, y_wall the wall line its front projects from, y_back its back face

podium.comment: AI 646 podium on the podium outline (the balcony-edge line, its corners sharp since user fix 1, 2026-10-15): positions along each run from its sharp start corner, v from the outline (outward +, the walls go to -depth). Corner piers wrap the corners (their faces where the plan's fillets ended + pier_ext); on run A they reach the entrance volume. The props lists are reservations for AI 628, 631, 632 and 633.

roof.comment: AI 647 roof: heights are above the roof slab top (z 27.250). Guard halves meet at the front and rear centres; the terrace runs from the guard shoe to the penthouse walls; every part above the roof stays under CAM_B8's sightline over the roof edge (sightline).

terrace_planters_ai629.note: planters and small trees behind the guard (b8), all round

wood.note: warm teak reveals and linings, flat: no wood texture is installed

soffit.note: AI 645's flat tone calibrated on b8's soffits (balconies.soffit_rgb); since user fix 17 the balcony soffits are veneer plates (TM_RB_soffit_veneer) and this slot is left on the entrance volume's covered top only

soffit_veneer.note: user fix 17: the veneer family (materials.veneer) with a satin, less glossy coat

materials.comment: AI 648 materials: families -> TM_RB_* slots (re-dressed by name). Stone = the kit limestone (assets/public/pbr/<set>, 4 m repeat) with joints cut as geometry: a groove of width w and depth d with a bevel b each side, its floor in the joint material; course planes from the datums' bands, vertical joints per flat face. Each panel gets its own UV offset (seeded) so the repeat does not show.

balcony_plants.comment: AI 627 balcony planting: pots at the reserved slots (moved 0.12 m in from the guard), floors [2, 3, 4, 5]; the plant sizes are targets above the soil (height, crown radius) the layer fits the game models to

podium_planters.comment: AI 628 podium planters: dark-metal boxes (modules of at most 2.4 m) on the upper recesses, behind the floor-1 guard (runs H, A, B) and on the entrance terrace. Plants are the game's viburnum forms fitted to a target height and crown radius; 'flowers' is the number of seeded flower heads the layer scatters over a box; 'keep_behind' lists the planes (point, outward normal) its foliage must stay behind: the guard glass and, on the upper recesses, the glazing frames

roof_planters.comment: AI 629 roof planters: a perimeter ring of low limestone troughs (modules of at most 2.4 m, one per corner) just inside the guard, planted with low viburnum; feature clusters (procedural cycads and spiky rosettes, linden olives, viburnum standards; no palms) at the corners and run midpoints and fill plants along the runs -- none along the front's middle, as b8 -- planter islands after the aerial, large pots with a small tree at the ring's corners and by the penthouse doors, and a low centre box with small trees, viburnum and flowers. 'keep_inside' is the loop the foliage must stay inside (the guard shoe's inner line); 'paths' the strips kept free before the penthouse's doors

roof_furniture.comment: AI 630 roof furniture after the aerial: groups in the frames of their terrace runs (u along, v in from the guard shoe's inner line); 'face' is each item's front (its local +v); 'size' its footprint (width along its local u, depth along v). The layer checks every footprint against the guard (at least clear_of_guard_m inside), the islands, the centre box, the pots, the door paths and the penthouse, and tags the pieces rb_hide_from_b8 for the CAM_B8 sightline check.

storefront_awnings.comment: AI 631 storefront canopies, one per podium bay: s along the bay between the pier faces, v from the storefront frames' outer face out past the podium outline (v 0), the slat plane's top falling from z_top[0] to z_top[1]; tie rods at 'rods' (s) pinned to a tab on the fascia's top and to an anchor plate on the lintel face centred at rod_anchor_z (config.hardware; user fix 6), moved off the podium's course joints from rod_anchor_design_z (user fix 13)

sidewalk_cafe.comment: AI 632 sidewalk café (site dressing): sets of an octagonal market umbrella over a round table and its chairs, 2 per reserved bay, v from the podium outline; a sidewalk slab along the front runs, its top at the ground floor level

street_dressing.comment: AI 633 street dressing (site): tall procedural street palms in raised limestone tree pits on the sidewalk before the front corners (b8's positions through CAM_B8) and at the far corners, low planting round each trunk; charcoal pots with cycads at the entrance spots AI 646 reserved; street lamps (the installed CC0 street_lamp_01, read-only) on the kerb side

entrance_plants.comment: user fix 12: a pot with a bird-of-paradise clump (proc/broadleaf, real leaves) each side of the entrance inside the portal, between the vestibule glazing and the wood lining; each clump is turned (from rot_deg) to keep inside keep_in

base.comment: AI 634 interior base: partitions dividing each residential floor into seven units (footprints cut flush on the pilaster line, the core, the chamfer columns' backs and an E-bay mullion), standing on each storey's floor up to the slab above; a downlight grid under every residential ceiling

restaurant_l0.comment: AI 635 ground-floor restaurant: dining bands behind every storefront bay (2-top and 4-top rows, an aisle behind each storefront door), the entrance zone under a slatted wood ceiling, banquettes on the core's side and rear walls, the bar on the core's front facing the entrance, a pendant over every table, potted plants at the band ends and the bar

dining_l1.comment: AI 636 upper-podium dining room: dining bands behind every upper bay (2-top and 4-top rows), the loggia room behind the front centre's glazing, banquettes on the core's side and rear walls, a sideboard on the core's front, two tables on the entrance terrace, a pendant over every indoor table, potted plants at the band ends, the sideboard and the loggia glazing

residential.comment: AI 637 residential: sheer curtains on a ceiling track behind every bay's glazing on floors 1-5, a left and a right panel per span drawn to seeded openings (closed / half / open, never the span's opening on the floor below; no two floors share a pattern; the narrow corner lights one panel), split at the partitions; a seeded lounge, dining or reading set with a floor lamp near the window of every bay of 3 m and more

penthouse.comment: AI 638 penthouse: the annex holds the kitchen (counter run with a lit shelf on the penthouse wall, an island with stools and pendants from the louvres) and a lounge corner; 2026-10-15: the penthouse ring is the lobby of the core (the roof-access headhouse: stair and lift doors on its front face), kept clear but for a console and plants; downlights, warm fills, plants
